art.alt: A sealed dwarven treasury with weapon racks, armour and an old chest

portals.label: Return through the concealed dwarven door

interactables.label: old dwarven chest
interactables.interactionText: The chest contains old coinage: up to 100 silver pieces and up to 100 gold pieces, determined when the treasure is claimed.

interactables.label: plate mail on the armour rack
interactables.interactionText: A complete suit of dwarven plate mail rests on the armour rack.

interactables.label: two-handed sword
interactables.interactionText: A heavy two-handed sword leans against the stone wall.

interactables.label: mace on the weapon rack
interactables.interactionText: A solid dwarven mace remains on its rack.
